data.standardized_narrative: At the 2017 year end the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (1 Jan 2017) was $230.962m. The technical reserves note reports a gross prior-year deterioration of $5.582m (i.e. strengthening of reserves), representing adverse claims development on prior years. The 2017 calendar year results were heavily affected by US, Caribbean and Mexico natural catastrophe events (Harvey, Irma, Maria and Mexican earthquakes) which impacted predominantly Property classes, but the prior-year reserve movement reported is a modest adverse adjustment to prior reserves rather than being driven by a single large prior-year event.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of $225,755,000 (2016: $142,768,000) is a deterioration of $5,582,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year (2016: release $3,362,000).

The 2017 results reflect a number of catastrophe losses in the third quarter. Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria hit the Caribbean and the US. In addition there were two Mexican earthquakes in September. These were predominantly property losses which hit the Property Direct & Facultative ("Property D&F") and Property Binding Authority classes.

The magnitude of the gross losses was well within the reinsurance programme for each loss there was an amount retained below reinsurance layers, reinstatement costs and a small amount of co-reinsurance on some lower layers.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the syndicate's presentation currency (USD) and expressed in millions. Opening reserves used the Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative (2016) gross figure. The prior-year movement ($5.582m deterioration) is taken verbatim from the Technical Provisions note; the note presents this as the gross prior year deterioration. Named catastrophes referenced (Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexican earthquakes) are 2017 events and affected the 2017 calendar year rather than being prior-year movements. No gross prior-year movement is broken down by line of business in the source; LOB-specific reserve movements are not quantified in the report.
